tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250tshogs bsgral ba'i skabs 'gugs byang ni/ 1$0000300oṃ saḥkarma dhā ki nī badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān shā trūn mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: rang nyid las byed kyi mkha' 'gro ma karma dhā ki nī'i skur gyur/ e yaṃ raṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐:

zhes dmigs rten gsal ba la/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka'= chos kyi bka'= dge 'dun gyi bka'= gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ chos nyid gdod nas stongs kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje phag mo khros ma nag mo mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus kyi lha tshogs rdo rje chos skyong ba'i srung ma bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthus ma rungs pa'i sems can bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig /oṃ saḥkarma dhā ki nī kī li kī la ya sarba shā trūn bigh+nān badz+ra aṅku dza: badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe ho: badz+ra pra we sha ya phaṭa: badz+ra ā be sha ya a ā: sgo bzhi'i dbye dbab kyi sngags rgya brjod cing g.yab rol sogs mthong brgyud ltar bya'o//
